ef_source: Central Electricity Authority, CO2 Baseline Database v22.0 (published August 2026; FY2025-26, Table S, adjusted for cross-border transfers): weighted average 0.675, CDM simple operating margin 0.963, build margin 0.446 and COMBINED MARGIN 0.705 tCO2/MWh (the CDM default is an equal-weight blend of the operating and build margins, and it is the convention's own factor for assessing a programme that adds new load), all at the generation busbar.
